correctness.rationale: The marked-box conditional expectation gives the covariance formula exactly: E[O | X1=r]=1_{r odd}+(B-1)(1-b^(N-r))/2 and EO=B(1-a^N)/2; p_Nr>0. For even r the monotone sequence Ba^N-(B-1)b^N falls below 1; for r=1 the relevant h_N starts at -1 then increases before decreasing to 0; odd r>=3 has s_r<0 and s_N→1, with first differences 2(b^(N-r)-a^N) switching sign at most once from + to -, so a unique negative-to-positive transition (possibly one zero) follows. The odd-frequency bracket strictly decreases with odd r at fixed B,N. Fixed-r compact density expansion is uniform O_r(B^-1); the limiting simple root yields lambda_r B+O_r(1). Independently enumerated allocations B=4,5, N=2..6 (40 direct exact covariance comparisons) and rational sign checks. This finite check is not the all-B,N proof.

value.rationale: A natural Hamming-weight observable of the nonlazy hypercube walk is compared with the historical coordinate-r frequency count. The exact checkerboard sign phase diagram, unique density threshold and finite error localization are useful structural dependence information, not merely a moment tabulation; the unexpected contrast with richness-frequency dependence motivates the theorem.

final_claim: For iid uniform allocation of N>=2 balls to B>=4 boxes and 1<=r<=N, exact Cov(odd-load-box count, r-frequency count) equals (B p_Nr/2)[(-1)^(r+1)+B(1-2/B)^N-(B-1)(1-2/(B-1))^(N-r)]; it is negative for even r, positive for r=1, and for each fixed odd r>=3 makes exactly one negative-to-positive discrete transition as N grows. Odd-frequency signs at fixed B,N are ordered; at fixed r the transition is at lambda_r B+O_r(1) where exp(2lambda_r)+2lambda_r+1=2r.
limitations: Uniform iid boxes, B>=4,N>=2,1<=r<=N only; limit fixed r and positive density N/B.
No extension to unequal box probabilities, growing r or other hypercube walks.
